meta.description: A plain terminal, a web dashboard installed on the server and Capstio, compared on four points: command syntax, agents on the server, seeing the command and where the SSH key lives.

title: Capstio compared with a terminal and a web dashboard
intro: Three ways to run a VPS with Docker, side by side on the things you deal with every day.

table.title: The comparison
table.intro: Each row is one criterion, each column one way of working.

scope.title: What this compares
items: Three ways of working: typing commands over SSH in a terminal, using a web dashboard installed on the server, and using Capstio on a Mac.
Four criteria: whether you must remember the syntax, whether an agent goes on the server, whether you see the real command being run, and where the SSH private key is stored.
The web dashboard column describes the category as a whole. Tools differ, so some cells say "Depends on the tool".
The Capstio column reflects what the beta does as of the date above.
Comparisons with specific products will get their own pages later.
